title: Commonly asked questions about transcriptional activation domains.
authors: Udupa, Aditya; Kotha, Sanjana R; Staller, Max V
one_liner_zh: 综述真核转录激活域（多为无序蛋白）通过蛋白-蛋白互作招募共激活因子的机制，并讨论其序列特征与预测，但缺乏AI/物理模拟方法，互作机制深度有限。
abstract: Eukaryotic transcription factors activate gene expression with their DNA-binding domains and activation domains. DNA-binding domains bind the genome by recognizing structurally related DNA sequences; they are structured, conserved, and predictable from protein sequences. Activation domains recruit chromatin modifiers, coactivator complexes, or basal transcriptional machinery via structurally diverse protein-protein interactions. Activation domains and DNA-binding domains have been called independent, modular units, but there are many departures from modularity, including interactions between these regions and overlap in function. Compared to DNA-binding domains, activation domains are poorly understood because they are poorly conserved, intrinsically disordered, and difficult to predict from protein sequences. This review, organized around commonly asked questions, describes recent progress that the field has made in understanding the sequence features that control activation domains and predicting them from sequence.
abstract_zh: 真核转录因子通过其DNA结合结构域和激活结构域激活基因表达。DNA结合结构域通过识别结构相关的DNA序列来结合基因组；它们是结构化的、保守的，并且可以从蛋白质序列中预测。激活结构域通过结构多样的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用招募染色质修饰因子、共激活因子复合物或基础转录机制。激活结构域和DNA结合结构域被称为独立的模块化单元，但存在许多偏离模块化的情况，包括这些区域之间的相互作用以及功能上的重叠。与DNA结合结构域相比，激活结构域由于保守性差、本质无序且难以从蛋白质序列中预测而了解较少。本综述围绕常见问题组织，描述了该领域在理解控制激活结构域的序列特征以及从序列预测它们方面的最新进展。
